newsitem.title: USA: Video Update to acquire Moovies.
newsitem.headline: Video Update to acquire Moovies.

text.p: Video Update Inc, an international video chain, agreed to acquire Moovies Inc, a Greenville, S.C-based video specialty retailer, in a stock-for-stock merger transaction which has an indicated value of $65.1 million.
Moovies currently operates 274 video specialty stores in 17 states throughout the United States and is the franchisor for an additional 43 stores.

Terms of the agreement call for shareholders of Moovies to receive 1.1 shares of Video Update class A common stock for each share of Moovies' common stock. About 13.7 million shares of Video Update will be used in the transaction.
Moovies shareholders will hold about 40 percent of Video Update's outstanding shares after the closing of the proposed transaction.
When the proposed merger is completed, Video Update's board will be expanded to nine directors with four representatives from Moovies.
"This transaction can provide the platform to significantly enhance our future growth opportunities," said Daniel Potter, chief executive officer of Video Update, in a news release.
In a related development, Video Update agreed to use Rentrack Corp's inventory management system for prerecorded videocassettes, if the proposed merger is completed.
Shares of Video Update closed at 4-3/4 unchanged from yesterday and shares of Moovies rose 7/64 to 4-47/64.
